verdict.rationale: Carta's docs cover cap table, option grant, and FMV/tax-calculation APIs but never document an end-to-end self-service exercise-and-pay-and-issue-shares flow for employees, and a first-hand account (carta-comm-6) describes attempting to exercise vested options online for ~$20k where Carta's payment collection failed (a bank transfer overdrafted the user) and Carta then permanently revoked the person's exercise rights without retry — a concrete hands-on failure of the exact capability. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the employee-facing exercise workflow itself, evidence of reliable payment processing, and confirmation that share issuance completes automatically post-payment.
